newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late SIR20 rubber, SIR3L edge down.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late SIR20 rubber, SIR3L edge down.

text.p: Indonesian benchmark tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices edged down in slow late trading on Friday due to continued weak demand, dealers said.
"We have lowered our offer prices by another 0.25 cents due to continued weak demand," one Padang-based dealer said.

Dealers said SIR20 offer prices for October/November edged down 0.25 cents/lb to 55.25-55.75 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan and to 55.00-55.50 cents fob Palembang, Surabaya and Padang, and to 54.75-55.25 cents fob Jambi and Pontianak.
One Jakarta-based dealer said shoe-grade SIR3L was last traded on Thursday at 137.65 cents/kg C&F New York November shipments.
SIR3L was last traded at 139.00 cents/kg for November deliveries, he said.
Dealers said RSS1, SIR3CV, SIR10 and SIR5 were also likely to stay soft in the coming days due to likely weak demand.
RSS1 was last traded at 133 U.S. cents/kg on Thursday, down from the previous 135 cents/kg following Japanese buying for early November deliveries, one Medan-based dealer said.
High amoniac grade latex with 60 percent dry rubber content was last traded at 2,230 rupiah/kg against the previous 2,250 rupiah in the local markets of Bandung and Tangerang, they said.
